scenario: LINT.6.1 — an interval has exactly three readable components: `start`, `end`, `duration`. Any other slot name on an IntervalConstruct target is a compile error. Pin: `(a..b).midpoint` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_BAD_INTERVAL_COMPONENT.
rules_ds:
schema W scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    window_start: Time mutable
    window_end: Time mutable

rule r:
    W m where (m.window_start..m.window_end).midpoint == m.window_start
->
    log info "x"
